course_version_verified.needed: Historical and target event official course ID/version; surface/distance/direction/rail, geometry effective dates; source original digest and authoritative publication
course_version_verified.route: JRA official meeting course/track notices or NAR + relevant organizer course specification and dated change notices

eligibility_verified.needed: Effective program/class rule with eligibility and amendment history; actual entrant age/earnings/points/transfer classification where applicable; exact native identity and race type
eligibility_verified.route: JRA annual and meeting program plus actual entries; LOCAL organizer class/points regulations for relevant meeting and entrant history

historical_publication_verified.needed: Authoritative publication/version timeline for every used historical field; correction inventory and immutable as-of witness; publication <= conservative cutoff
historical_publication_verified.route: provider-supplied archived edition or authenticated publication/correction receipts; no reconstruction from current page

capture_time_verified.needed: Exact source bytes matching proper hash domain; capture start/end, seal, timezone, uncertainty and immutable independent timestamp; parser version and row pointers
capture_time_verified.route: existing lawful immutable backup or prospective permitted capture; no substitution with new page

permission_cleared.needed: Written or otherwise established source-specific authorization for retrieval, retention, AI/cloud, derived output and intended sharing; versioned rights scope and revocation
permission_cleared.route: JRA/NAR/organizer inquiry drafts and terms, user approval before contacting; no contract or payment

benchmark_admitted.needed: All preceding five gates plus deduplicated representative as-of sample, consistent class/condition/time/units, DNF/ties exclusion rules, reference-clock definition and independent reproduction
benchmark_admitted.route: review group-specific cohort only after prerequisites; separate descriptive observed time from benchmark

scoring_authorized.needed: Approved benchmark, verified actual item semantic consumption and validation, explicit user approval and formal review; no fixed points or automatic grade
scoring_authorized.route: separate research acceptance and formal release decision

practical_plan: First: user decides scope of provider inquiry; existing drafts unsent; no charges or rights assumptions.

Second: only if authorized, seek existing immutable original bytes or provider archived edition and correction timeline. If absent, stop retrospective recovery and select a prospective clean capture research candidate, no outcome access.

Third: rebind native card and historical rows by issuer/event/runner/identity; resolve missing-card 26 and 13 class conflicts separately. Saga requires genuinely prestart current card or alternative candidate.

Fourth: verify each applicable field scope, publication and rights; pass only valid narrow observations; keep unresolved geometry/individual clocks/peer context missing. Do not require every measurement for a narrow observation.
Fifth: independent review of source authority, per-group benchmark and actual analysis consumption; explicit user approval before formal adoption.
